purpose: Fixes, before any public beacon is read, the complete chain of commitment batches for this generation: every batch file, its SHA-256, its count, and the hash of the deduplicated union of all commitment hashes. The sample to be revealed at season close is drawn from this union and from nothing else.
union_definition:
lowercase hex commitment hashes from every batch above, deduplicated, sorted ascending as strings, each followed by a single 
, concatenated and encoded as UTF-8
sampling_rule: score = sha256("SL-SAMPLE-v1|" + beacon + "|" + commitment_hash); select exactly K = min(100, n_commitments_unique) smallest scores, hex ascending
beacon: hash of the first Bitcoin block mined on or after 2027-07-01 00:00 UTC (announced before publication, outside SigningLab's control)
reveal_order: 1: commitments published while outcomes are unknown (done)
2: this cumulative manifest published before any beacon is read
3: at season close, full-population outcome file computed, frozen, SHA-256 published
5: payload + salt + outcome revealed only for the sampled entries
